query: I'm doing our Reaching Communities application and there's a box asking for evidence of need in the local area. We're an advice centre in Catford. what do I put, I need actual numbers not waffle

Our funder wants us to show we're reaching the most deprived neighbourhoods and not just whoever walks in. I've got a spreadsheet of last year's client postcodes (about 600 rows). How do I turn that into something for the bid?
need a paragraph on deprivation in Gateshead for a grant form, due tomorrow, we run a food bank
I ran the reach lens on our client list and saved the output as lens-result.json. Can you write up the need section for our bid to the City Bridge Foundation from it?
The trustees keep asking whether our befriending service actually serves the poorer parts of the borough. I want something evidence based for the fundraising pack, we cover Lewisham and Greenwich
writing a case for support for a youth club in Middlesbrough, can you help me evidence the level of need round here using IMD

Bid writer here. Client is a small homelessness charity in Hastings. The application asks 'how do you know there is a need for your project?' and I want to back it with deprivation data and who they reach rather than anecdotes.
can you compare where our service users live against how deprived those areas are? its for the monitoring section of a lottery grant and I have counts by neighbourhood already
Here are the figures the Kindtech tool gave me for our area. Help me word them for the 'local context' part of the application so I don't overclaim.

lens-result.json is what the reach lens gave us for the youth club. The trustees want a table of young people by deprivation decile but two rows came back blank, can you fill them in and tell me why some rows dropped out?

How far do people in our region live from our nearest advice centre? The trustees are deciding where a fifth one should go and I have the locations of the four we run.
The Kindtech result says 69.4% of our clients live in the most deprived neighbourhoods. Before I put that in the bid, can you show me step by step how it got there?
ran the who we are missing lens on our ethnicity counts and two of the groups came back blank. what do I tell the funder

Can you help me write the budget justification for our grant application? We're asking for £48,200 over two years: a part-time adviser at 21 hours a week, £3,000 for volunteer expenses and 10% overheads.
Which funders give grants to small debt advice charities in south London? Ideally ones that fund core costs.

Write a theory of change for a befriending project for isolated older people, for a funding application

how many people in Scotland live in the most deprived SIMD quintile? need it for a slide

Can you draft an equality, diversity and inclusion policy for our charity? We have 12 staff and about 40 volunteers.
My daughter needs census data on ethnic groups in Bradford for her geography A level coursework, where can she find it?
How long does the bus take from Catford to Deptford? One of our clients is asking how to get to the centre.
